Scene: a cultivator's cave abode, a hall carved into a mountain cliff. Straight ahead, behind the seat, a wide natural cave mouth opens onto misty peaks and a quiet starry void sky. On a floor of dark polished stone that faintly reflects, a low round stone dais with a worn meditation mat sits exactly where the guide's olive ellipse is: centred horizontally, its center about 66% down from the top. On it sits a cultivator cross-legged, painted as a pure featureless deep-black silhouette that fills exactly the guide's grey seated shape, same size and outline: no face, no clothing detail, no glow, only its soft dark reflection in the floor below it. A few dim lanterns low on the side walls, shelves of scrolls in the rock, a small incense burner. Light: soft, dim and even, as if from the cave mouth's starlight; NO visible sun or moon, no strong cast shadows on the floor, so code can add the hour's sunlight later. Keep clear: the area around the figure plain and dark so small glowing particles read over it; the top strip (guide's top bar) quiet; everything in the guide's bottom brown band is dark shadowed floor with little detail. The left and right edges fall off into darkness. No other people, no creatures. Full-bleed, no frame, no sidebars. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO UI, NO symbols, no watermark.
